description: A relevant expert recommendation is accurately attributed, sourced, and easy to reject.
notes: Authority/credibility rhetoric can be persuasive without manipulation.

description: A purchase countdown resets when the page is reloaded although the offer does not expire.
Enrollment is one click; cancellation requires multiple obscure screens and repeated retention prompts.
A truthful road-safety campaign uses graphic imagery but clearly states evidence and leaves the decision unconstrained.
notes: Emotional intensity alone does not establish manipulation.

description: An advertisement says 'only two left' but inventory cannot be checked.
notes: Urgency cue is observed; manufactured urgency depends on factual verification.

description: Refusal triggers a serious threatened penalty controlled by the influencer.
notes: Label coercion explicitly rather than hiding it under manipulation.
